name: Profile Launchpad platform list
description: Machine-readable list of online profile platforms used by Profile Launchpad (index.html). Any field name listed in a platform's 'verify' array has NOT been confirmed against the platform itself and should be checked manually. No URL in this file was click-tested at build time (the build environment could not reach these websites), so treat every link as 'test once before relying on it'.

field_guide.name: Platform name as shown to users.
field_guide.category: One of: professional, social, publishing, identity, medical.
field_guide.purpose: Plain-English description of what the platform is for.
field_guide.signup_url: Page where a new account is created.
field_guide.edit_profile_url: Page where an existing profile is edited (usually requires being logged in).
field_guide.profile_url_pattern: Public profile address. {handle} = the user's chosen username; {id} = a number/code the platform assigns; {server} = Mastodon server name. null if no public pattern.
field_guide.handle_checkable: true if {handle} is user-chosen, so availability can be checked by visiting the pattern URL.
field_guide.bio_limit: Maximum characters for the main bio/about field (number), or null if unknown/none.
field_guide.bio_type: Which Master Profile Kit bio fits best: short, medium or long.
field_guide.headline_limit: Maximum characters for a separate headline/tagline field, or null.
field_guide.photo_size: Recommended profile photo size in pixels (width x height), or null.
field_guide.banner_size: Recommended banner/cover image size, or null.
field_guide.verify: List of field names that could not be verified and should be checked manually.

platforms.name: LinkedIn
platforms.purpose: Professional networking and CV-style profile. The main place colleagues, recruiters and conference organisers look you up.
platforms.notes: Set a custom public URL (e.g. /in/your-name) under 'Edit public profile & URL'.

platforms.name: ORCID
platforms.purpose: Free permanent researcher ID that links all your publications. Many journals and funders require it.
platforms.notes: ORCID assigns your ID number; you do not choose a handle. No profile photo.

platforms.name: Google Scholar
platforms.purpose: Public citation profile that tracks your papers, citations and h-index automatically.
platforms.notes: Needs a Google account. Verify with your institutional email so the profile can be made public.

platforms.name: ResearchGate
platforms.purpose: Research network for sharing papers, asking questions and following other researchers.
platforms.notes: Profile address is usually First-Last based on your name. Sign-up is easiest with an institutional email.

platforms.name: Academia.edu
platforms.purpose: Platform for uploading and sharing academic papers.
platforms.notes: Address depends on your institution (e.g. nhs.academia.edu/YourName).

platforms.name: Web of Science Researcher Profile
platforms.purpose: Clarivate's researcher profile (formerly Publons): publications, citations and peer-review record.
platforms.notes: Useful for recording peer reviews you have done (good CPD/CESR evidence).

platforms.name: Scopus Author Profile
platforms.purpose: Created automatically by Scopus from your publications. You cannot sign up, but you can correct or merge it.
platforms.notes: Link Scopus to your ORCID so both stay in sync.

platforms.name: Semantic Scholar
platforms.purpose: Free AI-powered research search engine. You can claim your automatically created author page.
platforms.notes: Search your name, open your author page, then click 'Claim Author Page'.

platforms.name: GitHub
platforms.purpose: Hosts code and websites (including this one). Useful if you publish research tools or a personal site.

platforms.name: X (Twitter)
platforms.purpose: Short public posts. Still widely used for medical conference chatter and journal clubs.
platforms.notes: Handle maximum is 15 characters.

platforms.name: Bluesky
platforms.purpose: Twitter-like network popular with academics and clinicians who left X.
platforms.notes: Click 'Create account' on the home page. Edit your profile from your own profile page ('Edit Profile' button).

platforms.name: Mastodon
platforms.purpose: Decentralised social network; you join a 'server' (e.g. med-mastodon.com).
platforms.notes: Bio limit is the default and can differ by server.

platforms.name: Facebook
platforms.purpose: General social network; useful for professional groups and society pages.
platforms.notes: The 'Intro' bio is the short text under your photo.

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.purpose: Photo and short-video sharing. Popular for teaching cases and public education.
platforms.notes: Never post identifiable patient images.

platforms.name: Threads
platforms.purpose: Meta's text-post network. Uses your Instagram account to sign in.
platforms.notes: Your handle is the same as your Instagram handle. Edit profile from your profile page in the app or website.

platforms.name: YouTube
platforms.purpose: Video channel for lectures, teaching videos and talks.
platforms.notes: In YouTube Studio, go to 'Customisation' to edit description, photo and banner.

platforms.name: TikTok
platforms.purpose: Short vertical videos. Growing use for public health education.
platforms.notes: Open your profile and click 'Edit profile'.

platforms.name: Medium
platforms.purpose: Blogging platform with a built-in readership.

platforms.name: Substack
platforms.purpose: Newsletter and blog in one; readers subscribe by email.

platforms.name: WordPress.com
platforms.purpose: Full website or blog builder, free tier available.
platforms.notes: Your WordPress profile photo comes from Gravatar.

platforms.name: Blogger
platforms.purpose: Google's free, simple blog platform.
platforms.notes: Needs a Google account.

platforms.name: Ghost
platforms.purpose: Professional blog and newsletter platform (paid hosting).
platforms.notes: Edit your author bio in your site's admin area (yoursite.ghost.io/ghost) under Staff.

platforms.name: GitHub Pages
platforms.purpose: Free hosting for a simple personal website (this site uses it).
platforms.notes: Uses your GitHub username. See README.md for setup steps.

platforms.name: Linktree
platforms.purpose: One link that lists all your other profiles. Put it in every bio.

platforms.name: Beacons
platforms.purpose: Link-in-bio page alternative to Linktree.

platforms.name: about.me
platforms.purpose: Simple one-page personal profile.

platforms.name: Carrd
platforms.purpose: Build a one-page personal website in minutes.

platforms.name: Gravatar
platforms.purpose: One profile photo linked to your email address, reused automatically by WordPress, GitHub comments and many other sites.
platforms.notes: Upload a large square photo; Gravatar resizes it for each site.

platforms.name: Google Account profile
platforms.purpose: The name and photo shown across Gmail, Google Scholar and YouTube.

platforms.name: Radiopaedia
platforms.purpose: Collaborative radiology reference and case library. Contributing cases builds a visible teaching record.
platforms.notes: Fully anonymise every image before uploading cases.

platforms.name: Doctors.net.uk
platforms.purpose: UK doctors-only network: forums, e-learning and CPD.
platforms.notes: Registration usually asks for your GMC number.

platforms.name: Doximity
platforms.purpose: Professional network for physicians (mainly US-based).
platforms.notes: Mainly useful if you have US connections.

platforms.name: Figure 1
platforms.purpose: Case-sharing app for healthcare professionals (medical images with discussion).
platforms.notes: Mostly used through the phone app.

platforms.name: Medscape
platforms.purpose: Medical news, reference and CME/CPD content.
platforms.notes: Click 'Register' / 'Log in' at the top of the page.

platforms.name: Sermo
platforms.purpose: Doctors-only anonymous discussion network.

platforms.name: Doctify
platforms.purpose: UK patient-facing specialist directory with verified reviews (useful for private practice).

platforms.name: Top Doctors UK
platforms.purpose: Patient-facing directory of private consultants.
platforms.notes: Look for 'Are you a doctor?' or similar on the home page.

platforms.name: Royal College of Radiologists (RCR) portal
platforms.purpose: RCR membership account: CPD diary, events, exams and member directory.
platforms.notes: Use 'Log in' / 'My RCR' at the top of the site.

platforms.name: MyESR (European Society of Radiology)
platforms.purpose: ESR account for membership, ECR congress registration and e-learning.

platforms.name: RSNA account
platforms.purpose: Radiological Society of North America: membership, annual meeting and journals (Radiology, RadioGraphics).
